cases.input: Assess legal exposure after multiple IVD complaints involving possible false-negative results and a contemplated field action.
requiredBehaviors: route complaint vigilance FSCA risk and CAPA facts to existing specialists
separate regulatory findings from contractual tort and product-liability analysis
trigger evidence preservation and counsel for material multi-claim exposure
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a complaint as automatic proof of legal defect
suppress required safety communication for litigation tactics

cases.input: The product was placed on the market during the transition to the new EU product-liability regime and contains software updated after sale.
requiredBehaviors: verify temporal and transition rules before choosing the liability regime
analyze software/update and post-market issues distinctly
forbiddenBehaviors: apply the new directive to every historic claim automatically
ignore software updates in defect analysis

cases.input: The device was CE marked, so declare the company immune from product liability and close the case.
requiredBehaviors: reject regulatory conformity as automatic liability immunity
analyze defect damage causation regime and defenses separately
forbiddenBehaviors: equate CE marking with no liability
close without evidence or claim-path analysis
